title: Command Center human ready gate capture plan
description: Reproducibly captures a public-safe Command Center ready gate from the real UI, backed by a gateway-compatible fixture and public-safety assertions.

prepare-fixture.intent: Make a sanitized ready-gate run available to Command Center

open-command-center.intent: Show the real slot workspace at its human approval gate

verify-public-safe-gate.intent: Keep approval actions, proof artifacts, and public-safe labels visible together

capture-screenshot.intent: Preserve the complete ready gate for public review
